articles.title: England manager leaves trio out of Spain squad
articles.summary: England manager Thomas Tuchel has chosen to leave out Josh King, James Garner, and Jarrad Branthwaite from his final squad selection ahead of the upcoming match against Spain on Sunday night.

articles.title: Arsenal face hefty price tag for Antonio Nusa
articles.summary: Arsenal could be required to pay sixty-six million pounds to secure the services of RB Leipzig player Antonio Nusa. Meanwhile, Real Betis have reportedly turned down an official bid from Chelsea for Jose Morante, according to the latest football gossip.

articles.title: Spain boss insists country is free of racism
articles.summary: Spain manager Luis de la Fuente has firmly stated that there is no racism in Spain. Ahead of their upcoming Nations League clash in Madrid, England boss Thomas Tuchel mentioned he would remind his players of anti-racism protocols, though he does not expect it to be a problem.

articles.title: Bompastor tactics help Chelsea reach WSL summit
articles.summary: Managerial decisions proved to be the decisive factor as Sonia Bompastor guided Chelsea to the top of the Women's Super League. In tight encounters, fine margins often decide the outcome, and Chelsea's tactical approach successfully paid off to secure the crucial victory.

articles.title: Denmark defeat Portugal as Norway overcome Wales
articles.summary: Portugal suffered a heavy four-one defeat at home against Denmark in their first match since Cristiano Ronaldo's international retirement. Rasmus Hojlund scored twice to help Denmark secure the victory in Braga and move into second place in Group A4 of the Nations League.

articles.title: Chelsea edge Manchester City to claim WSL top spot
articles.summary: Chelsea leapfrogged Manchester City at the summit of the Women's Super League following a resolute one-nil victory. Sandy Baltimore scored a stunning goal in added time at the end of the first half, capping off a gritty and disciplined team performance from the visitors.

articles.title: Brazil stunned by Japan as Raphinha sees red
articles.summary: Brazil fell to a three-two defeat against Japan in an international friendly in Singapore. The match ended in chaotic fashion when substitute Raphinha and head coach Carlo Ancelotti were both sent off following protests over Tatsuhiro Sakamoto's late winning goal for Japan.

articles.title: Portugal permanently honour Cristiano Ronaldo's number seven
articles.summary: Portugal have made a permanent change to their national team kit by preserving the original number seven design to honor Cristiano Ronaldo. The legendary forward recently announced his retirement from international football after scoring one hundred and forty-six goals across two hundred and forty-six appearances.

articles.title: England thrash Australia to level ODI series
articles.summary: Tom Banton scored his second one-day international century and Gus Atkinson delivered a devastating new-ball spell to help England defeat Australia by one hundred and thirty-five runs in Adelaide, successfully forcing a series decider in Hobart.

articles.title: India fight back to secure ODI series victory
articles.summary: India mounted a strong comeback in the final fixture of the series, defeating New Zealand by twenty-two runs in Mount Maunganui. The low-scoring win handed New Zealand their first home one-day international series defeat since the year 2019.

articles.title: Australia crowned Rugby League world champions
articles.summary: Australia secured their fourth consecutive Rugby League World Cup title after defeating New Zealand thirty-two to twelve in the final. Jack Bostock and Liam Martin both put in standout performances to guide the Australian team to victory.

articles.title: Fernandes wants assurances before signing new contract
articles.summary: According to the latest newspaper reports and transfer rumors, Bruno Fernandes is waiting to see if Mauricio Pochettino proves to be a success before committing his long-term future to the club by signing a new contract.

articles.title: Bizarre stick incident gifts opponent easy goal
articles.summary: During an NHL match between the Winnipeg Jets and the Chicago Blackhawks, goaltender Spencer Knight suffered a bizarre moment when his stick became wedged in the advertising boards, directly leading to a goal for Kyle Connor.

articles.title: Australia win Women's Rugby League World Cup
articles.summary: Australia claimed a historic thirty-four to ten victory against their opponents in the Women's Rugby League World Cup final in Brisbane. Jaime Chapman played a starring role to guide the team to a dominant and memorable tournament win.
